description: This source file implements credential caching using UNIX domain sockets, including functions to communicate with a daemon, spawn the daemon, and handle different cache operations (get, store, erase, exit). It also contains command-line interface parsing logic for the 'git credential-cache' command.

methods.name: int connection_closed(int error)
methods.description: Checks if the connection was closed, differing for Windows native or Unix-like systems.

methods.name: int connection_fatally_broken(int error)
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates a fatal connection break, differing for Windows native or Unix-like systems.

methods.name: int send_request(const char * socket,const struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Establishes a UNIX socket connection and sends a request buffer, handles response.

methods.name: void spawn_daemon(const char * socket)
methods.description: Starts the credential cache daemon process.

methods.name: void do_cache(const char * socket,const char * action,int timeout,int flags)
methods.description: Performs cache operations like get, store, or erase by communicating with the daemon.

methods.name: char * get_socket_path(void)
methods.description: Resolves the socket path for the credential cache, either from the user-specified path or default location.

methods.name: void announce_capabilities(void)
methods.description: Announces credential cache capabilities to the external environment.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_cache(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function processing CLI arguments for the 'git credential-cache' command.
